requirements_summary: Workloads: chat-first support assistant + embeddings for doc search and personalization. Latency: p50 < 120ms for short chat turns, p95 target < 400ms for interactive flows. Throughput: steady-state ~300 reqs/min for chat, spikes to ~2k qpm during customer events. Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, looking for 20-40% unit cost reduction vs incumbent. Models: prefer tested open families (llama/variants) but need verified quality; fallback routing to smaller models for low-cost tiers. Routing: region-aware routing EU/NA, canary rollout to 5% of traffic during Dedicated launch. Security/compliance: require SSO (SAML), SOC2 attestation, audit logs, KMS for keys, and contract-level data residency guarantees for EU customers.
